svg.title: Julius Diesing — Selected Projects & Research
svg.text: Agent skill that reads, searches and annotates papers
in a local Zotero library alongside the researcher.
PRISMA review and benchmark of in-processing fairness
methods: accuracy, group fairness and economic utility.
Value effect in a panel of German listed firms and
market reactions to Brexit, analysed reproducibly in R.
Publication-ready templates for theses, seminar papers
and research reports in German academic typography.
